tooltips.forgermod.ability.delusion.name: Delusion
tooltips.forgermod.ability.delusion: Your next hit makes a mob stop targeting enemies for 20 seconds. Arm time: 30 seconds. Cooldown: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.delusion.card: Your next mob hit makes it forget aggression for 20 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.false_awakeni: Mark an enemy within 20 blocks and create a decoy that distracts nearby hostile mobs. Your next hit on the marked enemy deals 10/15/20/25% more damage. Duration: 30/35/40/45 seconds. Cooldown: 60/50/40/30 seconds.
Distract enemies with an echo; strike the real target for a bonus.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.overwhelming_: Blocked melee hits break shields. Your hits also deal 20% more armor durability damage.
Break blocking shields and deal 20% more armor durability damage.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.null_receipt: Ignore and store knockback from your next five damaging hits. Your next vertical axe slam releases the stored force as extra knockback. Duration: 30 seconds. Cooldown: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
Store knockback from five hits; release it in a vertical slam.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.distance_tax: Hitting an enemy marks it for 10 seconds. When the mark expires, it takes 0.5/0.75/1/1.25 damage per block between you, up to 40 damage. Hitting a different enemy moves the mark.
Mark an enemy on hit; it takes damage based on your distance after 10 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.echoing_speed: Repeated hits on one enemy add 5% attack speed each, up to 20/30/40/50%. The bonus resets when you change targets or go eight seconds without a hit.
Build attack speed with repeated hits on one enemy.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.death_stare: Teleport beside the mob under your crosshair. Range: 30/60/120 blocks; rank IV reaches any visible loaded mob. Cooldown: 45/40/35/30 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.death_stare.c: Teleport beside the mob directly under your crosshair.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.swing_attack: Hit every visible enemy within melee range for weapon damage. Cooldown: 30/25/20/15 seconds.
Strike every visible enemy in your melee range.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.strong_arm: Try to break one random armor piece on an enemy within melee range. Chance: 30/55/80/100%. Cooldown: 60/50/40/30 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.strong_arm.ca: Chance to break one random armor piece on an enemy within melee range.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.crucible_hook: Pull an aimed enemy within 20 blocks to you, then strike for 1.25/1.5/1.75/2 times weapon damage and burn it for 3/4/5/6 seconds. Cooldown: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
Pull an aimed enemy close, then smash and ignite it.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.nether_born: Deal 20% more melee and weapon explosion damage in the Nether.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.nether_born.c: Deal 20% more weapon damage in the Nether.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.explosive_hit: Your next 10 melee hits create blasts for 30% weapon damage. Blast radius: 3/4/5/6 blocks (7 at super rank). You and blocks are safe. Cooldown after the last hit: 45 seconds.
Ten hits explode for 30% weapon damage, without harming you.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.fire_resistan: Gain Fire Resistance while this weapon is in your main hand. At level II, it also works in your offhand.
Fire Resistance while held; level II also protects from offhand.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.heating_up: Fire damage is prevented. While burning, restore 1 HP every 2/1.75/1.5/1.25 seconds (rank V: 1 second). Neither protection nor healing works in lava; lava damage is never prevented.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.heating_up.ca: Prevent fire damage and slowly heal while burning. Does not work in lava.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.cold_bellows: Blocking with a shield burns the attacker or projectile shooter for 3/4/5/6 seconds while this claymore is in your main hand.
Shield blocks ignite the attacking enemy or projectile shooter.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.cinder_decoy: Leave a decoy that attracts hostile mobs for 6/8/10/12 seconds. When it disappears or is attacked, it explodes within 2/3/4/5 blocks and burns enemies for 3/4/5/6 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds.
Leave a decoy that attracts enemies, then explodes and burns them.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.explosion: Gain Resistance IV for 2 seconds and explode, damaging enemies within about 8 blocks. You and blocks are safe. Cooldown: 60/55/50/45 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.explosion.car: Gain brief Resistance IV and explode without hurting yourself or blocks.
tooltips.forgermod.dagger.tooltip: A compact carbon steel blade made for quick, precise strikes.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.heading: Passives:
tooltips.forgermod.passive.revenge.name: Revenge
tooltips.forgermod.passive.dagger.name: Dual Wield
tooltips.forgermod.passive.axe.name: Vertical Strike
tooltips.forgermod.ability.leech.name: Leech
tooltips.forgermod.ability.heading: Active Abilities:
tooltips.forgermod.ability.pyromaniac: While burning, hitting a mob extinguishes you and restores 2 HP. Passive; no cooldown.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.void_step: Teleport up to 10 blocks toward your aim, or 20 with a matching offhand dagger. Pass through plants, follow the ground when aiming downward, and stop just before obstacles. Cooldown: 7 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.sudden_presen: Teleport behind the nearest hostile mob within 20 blocks. Cooldown: 2 minutes.
message.forgermod.ability.unavailable: Ability cannot be used right now
tooltips.forgermod.ability.absolute_nigh: Your next two dagger hits inflict Weakness IV and Darkness V for 5 seconds at rank I, or 10 seconds at higher ranks.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.lucid_dreamin: Your next dagger kill grants Speed II for 30 seconds and halves fall damage for 15 seconds. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
message.forgermod.lucid.armed: Lucid Dreaming armed for your next enemy kill
tooltips.forgermod.ability.area_discharg: Strike hostile mobs within 5 blocks with lightning for half weapon damage. Each hit builds Charge Attack. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.charge_attack: Your next 20 mob hits gain 5% damage each, up to +100%. Hit 21 deals 20 extra lightning damage. Cooldown: 2 minutes.
message.forgermod.charge_attack.armed: Charge Attack armed for 21 mob hits
tooltips.forgermod.passive.chain_lightni: Hits have a 50% chance to chain to another hostile mob within 10 blocks, up to 10 times. Each arc deals half weapon damage.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.eye_of_the_st: Whirl nearby entities for 5 seconds and levitate living targets. Range: 10 blocks. Cooldown: 1 minute.
message.forgermod.eye_of_the_storm.activ: Eye of the Storm active for 5 seconds
tooltips.forgermod.ability.windy_dash: Launch yourself toward your aim. Cooldown: 5 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.double_jump: Jump once more in midair. Rank IV becomes Windwalker I and grants two air jumps; higher super ranks increase jump height. Matching dual wielded daggers can combine up to four air jumps.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.deep_wound: Your next critical dagger hit deals double damage and inflicts Slowness III for 5 seconds, with a purely visual blood burst on the target. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
message.forgermod.deep_wound.armed: Deep Wound armed for your next critical hit
tooltips.forgermod.ability.leech: Heal for 10/12/14/16% of the damage you deal with this dagger.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.rooting_roots: Root and poison hostile mobs within 10 blocks for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 1 minute.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.poisoned_vein: Your next dagger kill creates a poison cloud for 5 seconds. Anyone within 3 blocks, including you, receives Poison I for 30 seconds. Cooldown: 45 seconds.
message.forgermod.poisoned_vein.armed: Poisoned Vein armed for your next hostile kill
tooltips.forgermod.ability.strengthened_: Your next dagger kill grants 10 seconds of invulnerability. Cooldown: 90 seconds.
message.forgermod.strengthened_bones.arm: Strengthened Bones armed for your next hostile kill
tooltips.forgermod.ability.storing_anger: Deal no damage for 10 seconds, then add the stored damage to your next dagger hit. Cooldown: 1 minute.
message.forgermod.storing_anger.active: Storing Anger: damage is stored for 10 seconds
tooltips.forgermod.passive.death_march: Deal more dagger damage as the target loses health, up to double damage.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.revenge: Deal 20% more dagger damage to undead.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.sonic_crit: Your next critical dagger hit deals an extra 15% of the target's maximum health and releases a sonic boom. Cooldown: 30 seconds.
message.forgermod.sonic_crit.armed: Sonically Charged Crit armed for your next critical hit
tooltips.forgermod.ability.sonic_boom: Fire a piercing 3×3 sonic blast up to 50 blocks for twice your attack damage. Cooldown: 45 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.axe: Every third fully charged attack within 10 seconds slams a 3×3 area ahead. Requires an empty offhand.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.dagger: Dual wield daggers of the same material, even with different gemstones. Both apply their material hit effects.
tooltips.forgermod.axe.tooltip:
§7A heavy carbon steel head balanced for
hard, deliberate strikes.§r
tooltips.forgermod.rusty_axe.tooltip:
§7Its edge has flaked away beneath years
of rust. Old forge marks remain on the
haft.

Can be restored.§r
tooltips.forgermod.rusty_dagger.tooltip:
§7A small blade dulled by rust. It once
belonged to someone who travelled light.

Can be restored.§r
tooltips.forgermod.verdant_axe.tooltip:
§7Roots from a Lush Cave wrap around
this axe, gripping its head as firmly
as any smith's binding.§r
tooltips.forgermod.ghost_axe.tooltip:
§7Bone and iron from the Soul Sand
Valleys form an axe that feels lighter
than it has any right to be.§r
tooltips.forgermod.molten_axe.tooltip:
§7Forged beside the lava seas of the
Nether, this axe still carries the heat
of its first fire.§r
tooltips.forgermod.nullified_axe.tooltip:
§7An axe shaped in the End's cold void.
Light seems to fade along its edge.§r
tooltips.forgermod.woundmaker_axe.toolti:
§7Crystallized blood from the undead
runs through its head. Old stains
never leave the blade.§r
tooltips.forgermod.dreamweaver_axe.toolt:
§7An axe imagined into being in a dream.
Its outline shifts whenever you look away.§r
tooltips.forgermod.echoing_axe.tooltip:
§7Sculk from the deepest dark lines this
axe. Every blow leaves a faint echo
in the silence.§r
tooltips.forgermod.voltage_axe.tooltip:
§7A lightning strike charged its
Electrium head. Sparks gather where
the blade meets the haft.§r
tooltips.forgermod.skybreaker_axe.toolti:
§7Refined by storms at great heights,
its Taifunite head cuts through the
air with a restless whistle.§r
tooltips.forgermod.leafcutter_dagger.too:
§7A slim blade threaded with Lush Cave
vines. Its edge parts leaves without
slowing the hand that holds it.§r
tooltips.forgermod.deathwisper_dagger.to:
§7Bone remnants from the Soul Sand
Valleys give this pale dagger an
unsettling, whisper-quiet edge.§r
tooltips.forgermod.emberfang_dagger.tool:
§7A short Nether-forged blade that
still glows like an ember beneath
its darkened surface.§r
tooltips.forgermod.riftfang_dagger.toolt:
§7A sliver of the End's void shaped into
a dagger. Its edge seems to end beyond
where you can see it.§r
tooltips.forgermod.assassin_dagger.toolt:
§7Undead blood has crystallized along
this narrow blade. Its dark red edge
is made for a quick, close strike.§r
tooltips.forgermod.nightmare_dagger.tool:
§7A dagger born from a troubled dream.
Even awake, its shape is difficult
to remember clearly.§r
tooltips.forgermod.wardens_needle.toolti:
§7A sculk-tipped needle from the deepest
dark. Its narrow point is almost lost
against the shadows around it.§r
tooltips.forgermod.static_dagger.tooltip:
§7Lightning left a restless charge in
this small Electrium blade. Tiny
sparks dance along its edge.§r
tooltips.forgermod.dead_calm_dagger.tool:
§7A Taifunite dagger honed by high
winds. The air goes strangely still
just before it moves.§r
tooltips.forgermod.augment_template.tool: Store abilities at an Augmentation Table or Blaze Enchanter. Transfer compatible abilities in an anvil or Blaze Forger.
tooltips.forgermod.super_augment_templat: Stores ordinary abilities one rank above their normal limit. Named super augments still stop at super IV. Use an Augmentation Table or a supercharged Blaze Enchanter; transfer them in an anvil or supercharged Blaze Forger.
augmentation.forgermod.material_hit.name: Material Hit
tooltips.forgermod.augment_template.mate: Applies the receiving weapon's material effect on hit.
tooltips.forgermod.gemstone_upgrade_temp:
§7This template is used to infuse weapons
with gemstones increasing specific weapon stats.

Infuse your weapons at the Infusion Table!§r
tooltips.forgermod.ancient_upgrade_templ:
§7This template is used to forge advanced
weapons like claymores.

Forge weapons in the Forge!§r
tooltips.forgermod.claymore.tooltip:
§7A long Sword made from the best
Materials you found on your adventures.

Can be upgraded with every
§r§dsupreme Material.§r
tooltips.forgermod.rusty_claymore.toolti:
§7It looks like a claymore, but it's
extremely rusty, it barely even cuts
through grass. It must have been forged
hundreds of years ago.

Can be restored.§r
tooltips.forgermod.infernal_claymore.too:
§7A blazing claymore usually found in
ancient nether structures, made by
the ancients.§r
§7A dark and cool-looking claymore usually
found in the end, deep in the void.§r
tooltips.forgermod.overgrown_claymore.to:
§7A very old claymore which must have
been in a lush cave for a very long
time.§r
tooltips.forgermod.hollow_claymore.toolt:
§7A claymore reinforced by bones from
the enemies it killed. A truly scary
sword to possess.§r
tooltips.forgermod.curseblood_claymore.t:
§7A bloody claymore cursed by all the
enemies it defeated. It's being said
that it belonged to a psychopath long
ago.§r
tooltips.forgermod.dreambound_claymore.t:
§7A claymore sending enemies to eternal
rest. A claymore known as deadly as
death itself, and often used for killing
people while they are asleep.§r
tooltips.forgermod.shrieking_claymore.to:
§7A claymore found in the deepest depths,
reinforced with sculk, a material
from another dimension.§r
tooltips.forgermod.claymore_of_thunder.t:
§7A claymore charged by the might of
lightning, 1,000,000 volts of electricity
flow through this blade electrifying
everyone coming too close.§r
tooltips.forgermod.storming_claymore.too:
§7A claymore found at high altitudes, due
to the high wind speeds blowing everything
away.§r
tooltips.forgermod.inanisium_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material found in the void,
where nothing else is able to exist.§r
tooltips.forgermod.ignisium_ingot.toolti:
§7A supreme material found deep in the
nether, mostly submerged in lava
and magma.§r
tooltips.forgermod.pulsite_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material found in the deepest
depths, in a very dark environment.§r
tooltips.forgermod.somnium_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material that can only be
imagined. It may appear in your 
dreams.§r
tooltips.forgermod.vulnusium_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material found deep in the flesh of undead monsters, where blood
crystallizes to a very strong material.§r
tooltips.forgermod.morsium_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material found deep in the
Soulsand Valleys, mostly under a pile
of bones and remnants.§r
tooltips.forgermod.lush_ingot.tooltip:
§7A supreme material found mostly in
Lush Caves, where plants are 
thriving, and new live emerges.§r
tooltips.forgermod.electrium_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material charged up by a
highly energized lightning strike, it 
is said that it's the secret behind the creeper's
ability to charge up.§r
tooltips.forgermod.taifunite_ingot.toolt:
§7A supreme material refined by endless storms and
strong winds blowing on high
altitudes.§r
tooltips.forgermod.developium_ingot.tool:
§7A supreme material made up by the
genius (BananasHelp20), who made the
mod, in cooperation with
ALLESBANANE11§r

§dCreative only!§r
tooltips.forgermod.carbon_steel_cross_gu:
§7A good sword needs a cross guard,
protecting the owner from hits of
enemies.§r
tooltips.forgermod.sharpened_blade.toolt:
§7A blade sharpened till all of the
fingers bleed, the smith of this
blade must have been extremely
focused on sharpening the blade.§r
tooltips.forgermod.handle.tooltip:
§7This handle is used for more advanced
weapons, than the regular ones.
It's very stable and way harder
than a simple stick.§r
tooltips.forgermod.advanced_handle.toolt:
§7This handle is used for the best
weapons imaginable, extremely stable,
and very comfortable to hold.§r
tooltips.forgermod.amethyst.tooltip:
§7A very dense and fine variant of the
amethyst found in geodes, it's absolutely
flawless.

When applied to a Weapon:§r
§5+0.4 Attack Speed§r
tooltips.forgermod.amber.tooltip:
§7It burns your finger upon touching it.
It's a flawless, yet extremely hot stone
and you've never seen something like it
before.

When applied to a Weapon:
§r§6makes item fire resistant§r
tooltips.forgermod.ruby.tooltip:
§7A sharp and edgy stone. It's shining
as red as the blood your enemies
bleed when killed with a very sharp
weapon.

When applied to a Weapon:§r
§4+1 Damage§r
tooltips.forgermod.jade.tooltip:
§7A precious jewel that strengthens status effects.
Requires a weapon with a learned status-effect augment.

When infused:§r
§2+1 Effect Level
+1 Second Effect Duration§r
tooltips.forgermod.amber.tooltip_extra:
§7
Gemstone: [§r§6Amber§r§7]
Gemstone bonus:§r§6
Item fire resistance§r
tooltips.forgermod.jade.tooltip_extra:
§7
Gemstone: [§r§2Jade§r§7]
Status-effect augment bonus:§r
§2+1 Effect Level
+1 Second Effect Duration§r

tooltips.forgermod.passive.warden_tone.c: Suppress your sculk vibrations while holding this weapon. Taking damage still reveals you.

Gain 5% attack speed for each enemy within ten blocks.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.unfinished_dr: Killing an enemy before it damages you heals half a heart.
Killing an enemy before it hits you heals half a heart.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.just_a_dream: Teleport to your respawn point, even across dimensions. If it is unavailable, go to world spawn. Cooldown: 60/50/40/30 seconds.
Teleport safely to your respawn point, even in another dimension.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.sleepwalker: Deal 10% more melee damage at night.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.sleepwalker.c: Deal 10% more melee damage at night.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.lullaby.name: Lullaby

tooltips.forgermod.ability.lullaby.card: Sleep an aimed mob for three seconds; damage wakes it. Players receive brief Slowness.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.dream_feast: Restore 8 hunger and 8 saturation, even when hunger is full.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.dream_feast.c: Restore eight hunger and eight saturation points.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.daydreamer: Gain Jump Boost I while holding this axe during the day.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.daydreamer.ca: Gain Jump Boost I while holding the axe during daytime.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.pillow_armor: Take 25% less fall damage while holding this axe.
Take 25% less fall damage while holding the axe.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.magnetic_thro: Launch an aimed enemy within melee range toward your aim. Force: 1.1/1.3/1.5/1.7. Cooldown: 25/20/15/10 seconds.
Launch an enemy within melee reach along your look direction.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.live_wire: Melee attackers take 2 damage when they hit you for 8 seconds. Cooldown: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.live_wire.car: For eight seconds, reflect two damage to melee attackers.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.quick_recharg: Fully charged critical hits shorten this weapon's primary cooldown by 1 second, once every 2 seconds.
Charged critical hits shorten the primary cooldown by one second, once every two seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.conductive_ed: Deal 20% more melee damage to enemies in water or rain.
Deal 20% more melee damage to wet enemies.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.static_blade: Your next swing sends a 4-block-wide echo up to 20 blocks, dealing weapon damage. A matching offhand dagger sends a second echo. Arm time: 30 seconds. Cooldown: 40/35/30/25 seconds.
Send a wide damaging echo forward; a matching offhand dagger sends another.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.lightning_rod: Lightning cannot hurt you while you hold this weapon. Strikes grant 5 absorption hearts and Strength I for 30 seconds. Under open sky, extra strikes can occur even without a storm.
Lightning is harmless and grants five absorption hearts plus Strength I; extra strikes need no storm.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.alternating_c: Your next hit links two visible enemies within 20 blocks. For 1 minute, they alternate 0.5-second stuns each second. Arm time: 30 seconds. Cooldown: 120/100/80/60 seconds.
Link two enemies; brief stuns alternate between them for 1 minute.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.direct_curren: Mark 2/3/4/4 enemies with melee hits to stun them and form damaging barriers for 20 seconds. Barriers deal 4 damage on contact. Rank IV unlocks Static Field, which also damages anyone inside the marked triangle. Cooldown: 120/100/80/60 seconds.
Mark enemies to create damaging barriers; Static Field also damages targets inside.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.stunning_pres: For 30 seconds, pulse 1 damage and a brief stun to visible enemies within 10 blocks every 2/1.65/1.35/1 seconds. Cooldown: 60/50/40/30 seconds.
Pulse damage and brief stuns to visible enemies within 10 blocks.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.heavy_current: Deal 15% more melee damage to enemies wearing a full set of armor.
Deal 15% more melee damage to fully armored enemies.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.downdraft_bel: For 10 seconds, pull airborne mobs above you toward the ground within 4/6/8/10 blocks horizontally. There is no height limit. Cooldown: 30/25/20/15 seconds.
Pull airborne mobs above you to the ground for 10 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.crosswind: Deflect incoming projectiles away from you for 2 minutes. Your own shots are unaffected. Cooldown: 180/160/140/120 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.crosswind.car: Deflect incoming projectiles for two minutes.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.slipstream: Sprint behind a moving ally within 3 blocks to gain 10% movement speed.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.slipstream.ca: Sprint behind a moving ally to gain a small speed bonus.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.upwind.name: Upwind

tooltips.forgermod.ability.upwind.card: Your next melee hit adds knockback and launches the enemy upward.

tooltips.forgermod.ability.windcharge.ca: Launch upward and avoid landing damage; Skybreaker adds a falling smash against all mobs.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.vacuum_burst: Pull dropped items and experience within 6/8/10/12 blocks toward you.
Pull nearby drops and experience toward you.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.headwind.name: Headwind
tooltips.forgermod.passive.headwind: Sprinting causes half as much hunger exhaustion while you hold this weapon.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.feather_shelt: Give yourself and allies within 4/6/8/10 blocks Slow Falling for 10 seconds.
Give yourself and nearby allies 10 seconds of Slow Falling.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.pocket_storm: Your next melee hit also strikes enemies within 3 blocks for weapon damage and strong knockback.
Arm a melee hit to create an area smash with strong knockback.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.flaming_stomp: Your next axe attack becomes a vertical 5×5 strike ahead of you, dealing weapon damage and burning enemies for 5 seconds. Cooldown: 2 minutes.
Your next axe attack becomes a fiery 5×5 vertical strike.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.flameborn: Gain Fire Resistance for 30 seconds. A fire burst ignites you and enemies within 10 blocks for 5 seconds (7 at super rank). Cooldown: 5 minutes.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.flameborn.car: Gain Fire Resistance and ignite yourself and nearby enemies in a fire burst.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.ender_swing: Immediately swing to damage enemies within 1 block and lift them 20 blocks if the path is clear. Requires no other augment. Super rank adds 20% damage. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.ender_swing.c: Immediately swing to damage nearby enemies and lift them into the air.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.blood_rush: Spend 2 health to gain Speed II for 10 seconds. Cannot be used if it would kill you.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.blood_rush.ca: Spend 2 health points for 10 seconds of Speed II.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.final_strike: Deal 50% more damage to your most recently hit enemy when it has under 10% health.
Deal 50% more damage to your last hit enemy below 10% health.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.blood_sacrafi: Spend half your health and absorption to deal double weapon damage for 20 seconds.
Sacrifice half your health and absorption for 20 seconds of double damage.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.scar_compass: Your most recently hit enemy glows for 10 minutes while you hold this weapon.
Mark your most recently hit enemy with a 10-minute glow.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.revengeful_ex: Dying to an enemy explodes for weapon damage within 5 blocks and deals 5 times weapon damage to your killer.
On death, damage nearby entities and deal 5 times weapon damage to your killer.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.lush_jungle: Killing an enemy bonemeals the block beneath it.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.lush_jungle.c: Enemy kills bonemeal the block beneath them.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.sunfed.name: Sunfed

tooltips.forgermod.passive.sunfed.card: Sunlight restores one hunger and one saturation point every 15 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.photosynthesi: Restore 1 weapon durability every 15 seconds while holding it in daylight.
Slowly repair this weapon while holding it during daylight.

tooltips.forgermod.ability.green_feast.c: One wheat restores one heart and two saturation points.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.sapling_harve: Kills have a 15% chance to drop an extra sapling.
Enemy kills may drop an extra sapling (15% chance).
tooltips.forgermod.passive.compost.name: Compost

tooltips.forgermod.passive.compost.card: Eat rotten flesh without its Hunger effect.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.lumberjack: Breaking logs with this axe costs no durability.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.lumberjack.ca: Mine logs without using weapon durability.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.ghostwalk: Become invisible for 10 seconds or until you attack. Rank IV unlocks Jumpscare Horror: your opening hit deals double damage. Super ranks extend invisibility to 10/12/14/16 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.ghostwalk.car: Vanish until attacking. Super form doubles your invisible opening hit.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.soul_hunger: Kills grant 1 absorption heart, up to 3 hearts. The bonus remains when you switch weapons.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.soul_hunger.c: Enemy kills grant 2 absorption health, up to 6.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.last_stand: Survive a fatal hit with 1 health once every 2 minutes.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.last_stand.ca: Survive a fatal hit at 1 HP, once every 2 minutes.

Necromancer IV equips Power II/Flame bows and diamond/iron swords. Allies last 1 minute and remain after switching weapons.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.bone_guard.ca: Summon reinforcements for 1 minute. Upgrades change their lineup and equipment.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.skull_throw: Fire a slow wither skull that bursts on impact for weapon damage and Wither I for 5 seconds.
tooltips.forgermod.ability.skull_throw.c: A slow skull bursts for weapon damage and brief Wither.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.echo_appetite: Breaking sculk blocks restores half a drumstick; killing a Warden restores 2 drumsticks.
Break sculk blocks for half a drumstick; defeat a Warden for two drumsticks.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.resonance_cri: Fully charged hits critically strike jumping enemies, even while you are grounded.
Fully charged hits critically strike jumping enemies.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.aftershock: Fully charged hits deal 1 more damage after 1 second.
tooltips.forgermod.passive.aftershock.ca: Charged melee hits echo for one damage after one second.

death.attack.forgermod.aftershock.player: %1$s was silenced by an aftershock from %2$s

Your next hit damages the enemy's held weapon by 15 durability.

tooltips.forgermod.passive.stone_song.ca: Holding this blade below Y=0 grants two armor points.
